title: The Weather Turns
subtitle: Flowers, ice, rainbows — and what's to come

exercises.prompt: What grows (wachse) in the Gaarde in Frühyaahr?

exercises.statement: When it is frostich and kalt, Wasser turns to Iis.
exercises.explanation: Ya — in the cold (kalt) winter, water (Wasser) freezes into ice (Iis).

exercises.statement: After the Rege, when the Sunn comes out, you might see a Reggeboge.
exercises.explanation: Ya — sun (Sunn) after rain (Rege) makes a rainbow (Reggeboge).

exercises.statement: "Es watt kalt" means "it is getting cold" (it will turn cold).
exercises.explanation: Ya — "Es watt ___" says the weather is becoming that way: Es watt kalt (turning cold), Es watt Winder (winter is coming).

exercises.prompt: Build the sentence: "It is getting cold."
Match each word to its meaning
